title: TERRAIN SYNTH -- 8-voice wave-terrain synth: two orbits scanning two 3D terrains

sections.heading: USING IT
lines: Turn on audio with the speaker button, then play the keyboard or a MIDI keyboard.
TERRAIN A / B menu: the surface each oscillator reads (19 sources incl. noise and an image file).
DETAIL and REGEN: change the resolution of the surface and roll a new random one.
ORBIT A / B: SHAPE plus RADIUS X/Y, ROTATE, LOBES, LOBE AMT set the path over the terrain.
FEEDBACK bends the path with its own output, DRIVE adds saturation.
ZOOM HZ shrinks the orbit above that pitch so high notes stay tame.
ORBIT CENTRE pads: drag to move each orbit across its terrain.
TERRAIN MOD A + B: an audio-rate wobble of both orbits (RATIO to the note, + HZ, X/Y/R DEPTH).
OSC MIX: A > B MIX crossfades the two oscillators.
OSC B PITCH: B RATIO (0.5-4 in steps) and B DETUNE (+/-50 cents).
3D VIEW: ON, ROTATE, TILT for the terrain pictures. A white dot follows each playing orbit.
CHEBY CORE: switch a slot to a bandlimited Chebyshev core with a preset menu and BRIGHT.
ANIMATE: ON and FPS run the animation. Per slot, MORPH blends toward SOURCE 2 (AUTO HZ sweeps it).
EXCITE (or NOTE, on every note) starts a ripple. TENSION and DAMP shape the ripple.
MOTION LFO / ENV 2: per-voice LFO and second envelope, with depths to each orbit.
FILTER (CUTOFF, RESO, ENV > HZ), ENVELOPE (ADSR) and OUTPUT (VOLUME, scope).
OVERSAMPLE: run the voices at 1x, 2x or 4x to reduce aliasing (more CPU).

sections.heading: HOW IT WORKS
lines: Each terrain is a 256x256 Jitter matrix copied into a buffer~ the audio can read.
poly~ terrain-voice runs 8 voices. Each has two gen~ oscillators that trace an orbit at note pitch.
The height of the terrain under the orbit is the waveform, then svf~ filter and adsr~ envelope.
